title: 实验报告与学术规范
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/184_实验报告与学术规范.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/184_实验报告与学术规范/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一份装订好的实验报告
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a neatly stapled report with blank pages and a small reference list icon, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十二课：实验报告与学术规范。

shots.scene: 阿杰从网上复制了一大段文字粘进报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student copies a large block from a web page into his report on a laptop, a red warning icon. The screens are blank.
shots.narration: 阿杰从网上整段复制，粘进了报告。

shots.scene: 王老师指着查重报告上的红色高亮
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a similarity check printout covered with red highlighted blocks, shaking his head. The page has no readable text.
shots.narration: 王老师：不注出处，这就是抄袭。

shots.scene: 小研：结构、引用、诚信，一起学
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a writing guide and a reference list icon, smiling at the young male student.
shots.narration: 小研：报告怎么写、怎么引，一起学。

shots.scene: 报告：描述并分析一项实验
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask icon turning into a report document with a magnifier for analysis. No text.
shots.narration: 实验报告：描述一项实验，并加以分析。

shots.scene: 让人看得懂、能重复、接着做
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report passed to three person icons, one reading, one repeating the experiment, one building a next step. No text.
shots.narration: 让别人看得懂、能重复、能接着做。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a classroom, a research institute and a company lab icon, each with a report. No text.
shots.narration: 课堂、科研院所、企业实验室都离不开。

shots.scene: 为什么做、怎么做、得到什么、有何意义
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four boxes with a question mark, a wrench, a chart and a star icon. No text.
shots.narration: 说清为什么做、怎么做、得到什么、意义。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stacked document outline with eight colored sections from top to bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 标题、摘要、引言、方法、结果、讨论、结论。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short title bar at the top of a page highlighted, a long winding title crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 标题：一句话简明说出实验重点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small box condensing four icons, a target, a wrench, a chart and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 摘要是缩影：目的、方法、结果、结论。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stack of books and a target icon feeding into the introduction section. No text.
shots.narration: 引言：交代背景和目的。

shots.scene: 说明为什么值得做，提出假设
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light bulb and a question card at the end of the introduction section. No text.
shots.narration: 说明为何值得做，最后提出假设。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of reagent bottles, an instrument and numbered steps under the methods section. No text.
shots.narration: 材料与方法：材料、仪器、步骤。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: another person icon following the methods section and getting the same result. No text.
shots.narration: 写清楚，别人照着就能重做一遍。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a methods section with icons of a microbe, a hazard pictogram and goggles. No text.
shots.narration: 方法里写明菌种、危险化学品和防护。

shots.scene: 几级实验室、废物怎么处理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab level badge and a waste container with an arrow to a disposal icon. No text.
shots.narration: 在几级实验室做，废物怎么处理。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reader of the report filling a risk checklist before entering a lab. No text.
shots.narration: 后人照做，也要先评估、经同意。

shots.scene: 表格、图表、图片呈现数据
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a results section with a table grid, a bar chart and a photo frame. No text.
shots.narration: 结果：用表格、图表和图片呈现数据。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: data icons on one side and an explanation speech bubble held back by a stop hand. No text.
shots.narration: 这里只摆事实，先不解释。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unexpected data point kept in the chart with a check mark, an eraser crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不合预期的数据，也要如实呈现。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a result chart next to a hypothesis card with a yes or no balance. No text.
shots.narration: 讨论：解释结果，支不支持假设。

shots.scene: 分析异常，对照已有知识
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an odd data point with a magnifier and a link to a stack of published papers. No text.
shots.narration: 分析异常原因，和已有知识对照。

shots.scene: 结论：主要发现、意义、下一步
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a conclusion box with a star for findings and an arrow pointing to next steps. No text.
shots.narration: 结论：主要发现、意义和下一步。

shots.scene: 引用的全部列进参考文献
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: in text citation markers linked one to one with entries in a reference list. No text.
shots.narration: 引用过的来源，一一对应列全。

shots.scene: 附录放补充数据和计算
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an appendix section holding extra tables and calculation sheets, the main text kept slim. No text.
shots.narration: 附录有需要才加，放补充数据和计算。

shots.scene: 报告数据注明记录本页码
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report chart with a link arrow back to a numbered notebook page. No text.
shots.narration: 报告数据能追到记录本页码。

shots.scene: 底稿和原始数据按规定保存
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report, draft versions and a data folder going into an archive box with a calendar. No text.
shots.narration: 报告、底稿和原始数据，按规定存档。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trash bin with data files crossed out and a backpack with a notebook crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 交了报告，原始数据也不能删。

shots.scene: 先弄清别人已知道什么
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student icon at a library shelf and a database search icon. No text.
shots.narration: 背景调研：先弄清别人已经知道什么。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a research map with a next step arrow to a lab bench. No text.
shots.narration: 加深理解，知道去哪找，规划下一步。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet icon, an accident report icon and an approval stamp in a research folder. No text.
shots.narration: 也要查材料危害、前人事故和所需审批。

shots.scene: 选一个真正感兴趣的题目
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several topic cards with one picked by a hand, a heart icon on it. No text.
shots.narration: 选一个自己真正感兴趣的题目。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crop plant icon with several question marks listed beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 如一种改良作物，写下想弄清的问题。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wide funnel narrowing many questions down to one focused question. No text.
shots.narration: 再收窄焦点，只研究一个主题。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a skeleton spine icon running through a paper outline, one sentence bar highlighted in the introduction. No text.
shots.narration: 论点句是骨架，一句话说出主旨。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thesis card being revised several times with arrows, each version a bit sharper. No text.
shots.narration: 调研越深，论点一改再改，很正常。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an outline drawn as a road map with numbered stops leading to a finished paper. No text.
shots.narration: 提纲像路线图，带你一步步写完。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reference list where each entry has a short note box beneath it. No text.
shots.narration: 注释书目：每条文献附一段说明。

shots.scene: 讲什么、有何关系、靠不靠谱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three small icons under an entry, a summary icon, a link icon and a trust shield. No text.
shots.narration: 讲什么、和题目的关系、靠不靠谱。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small stack of index cards with source cards and note cards, a deadline calendar. No text.
shots.narration: 也可用资料卡、笔记卡，按时提交。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a journal, a textbook and an official publication icon with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 引用选可信来源：期刊、教材、官方出版物。

shots.scene: 人人可改的网站只作起点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an editable web page icon with a pencil used as a signpost pointing to journal articles. No text.
shots.narration: 人人可改的网站，只作找文献的起点。

shots.scene: 参阅过、引用过的都要列
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reference list with every entry checked, none missing. No text.
shots.narration: 参阅过、引用过的，按格式列进文献表。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a printed page showing a neatly formatted numbered reference list, a finger pointing at one entry.
shots.narration: 国内常按国家标准著录参考文献。

shots.scene: 顺序编码或著者-出版年
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two citation styles side by side, numbered markers and author year markers. No text.
shots.narration: 顺序编码制或著者出版年制，按要求选。

shots.scene: 以学校和期刊要求为准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a school badge and a journal icon with a format checklist. No text.
shots.narration: 具体格式，以学校和期刊要求为准。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand moving a text block from another paper into one's own paper, a red mask icon. No text.
shots.narration: 把别人的文字当自己的，是故意抄袭。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a borrowed idea in a paper without a citation marker, a forgotten note icon. No text.
shots.narration: 忘了注明出处，也算抄袭。

shots.scene: 短的加引号，长的单独成段
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short quote in quotation marks and a long quote set as an indented block, both with citation markers. No text.
shots.narration: 短引文加引号，长引文单独成段。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an in text marker linked to an entry in the end reference list, a shield icon. No text.
shots.narration: 文中标注加文末列表，就能预防抄袭。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance icon above a paragraph with a neutral tone, emotional emoji faces crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 科学写作客观表述，人称按期刊要求。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: slang speech bubbles crossed out and a complete sentence bar checked. No text.
shots.narration: 不用口语、俚语和随意简写，句子完整。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scientific name shown as slanted letters shapes next to a microbe icon. No text.
shots.narration: 生物学名用斜体。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a first draft with many red pen marks, then a clean revised version. No text.
shots.narration: 初稿写完，编辑修改是必经一步。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with a spelling icon, a grammar icon and a supporting pillar under a thesis card. No text.
shots.narration: 查错字语法，要点撑得住论点吗？

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a paper with three sections checked, then a person reading it once more. No text.
shots.narration: 引言、正文、结论齐不齐，再通读一遍。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons with red stamps, a copied page, a fake chart and an altered number. No text.
shots.narration: 抄袭、伪造、篡改数据，都是学术不端。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an author list with an unearned name crossed out and one paper sent to two journals crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不当署名、一稿多投，也不允许。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person avoiding a toxic powder icon and writing made up weighing numbers, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 怕接触毒物就编数据，是造假。

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student weighs a powder inside a ventilated enclosure wearing goggles, gloves and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 解决办法是做好防护，绝不是造假。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an academic committee table with a document and a stamp, a scale of justice icon. No text.
shots.narration: 学校依规调查处理，后果很严重。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student swap printed drafts across a table.
shots.narration: 同伴互评：审阅同学作品，提出建议。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rubric sheet first, then a draft read twice with notes marked on the second pass. No text.
shots.narration: 先看评分表，通读一遍，再对照写反馈。

shots.scene: 内容、结构、语法、效果、格式
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five tabs on a folder with icons for content, structure, grammar, effect and format. No text.
shots.narration: 从内容、结构、语法、效果、格式入手。

shots.scene: 先说优点，再提建议，多提问
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thumbs up, a lightbulb suggestion and a question mark speech bubble in order. No text.
shots.narration: 先说优点，提建议，看不懂就提问。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thesis card held up by pillars of evidence, one weak pillar highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 看内容：论点有没有支撑，证据恰当吗？

shots.scene: 围绕一个中心，题目够窄
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: paragraphs orbiting one central idea, a narrow topic funnel. No text.
shots.narration: 看结构：围绕一个中心，题目够不够窄。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three sections with check marks, the introduction pointing ahead, the conclusion pointing back to the question. No text.
shots.narration: 引言指方向，正文连论点，结论回应问题。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: smooth bridge arrows between paragraphs and a sharp focused word icon. No text.
shots.narration: 看效果：用词具体，过渡顺，抓得住人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: each quote bubble in a paper linked to a source icon, one missing link highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 看引用：每条引语都有交代和出处。

shots.scene: 文中引的表里有，表里的文中用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two way arrows between in text markers and the reference list, an extra unused entry crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 文中引的表里有，表里列的文中用。

shots.scene: 核查文献真实、引述忠实
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier checking that a cited paper exists and that the quote matches the original page. No text.
shots.narration: 核查文献是否存在，引述是否忠实原意。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a paragraph with a typo, a wrong punctuation mark and a broken sentence circled. No text.
shots.narration: 看语法：错字、标点、搭配，影响原意。

shots.scene: 封面、标题、篇幅、行距、边距
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a page layout with margin guides, line spacing marks and a cover page icon. No text.
shots.narration: 看格式：按课程和学校规定统一。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a draft in a locked folder, a copy machine and a borrowing hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别人的稿子，评完不外传、不挪用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a friendly speech bubble pointing at the page, an angry finger at a person crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 评语对事不对人，语气友善。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reviewer stepping aside from a draft with a conflict of interest icon, a balance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 客观打分；有利益冲突，主动回避。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report outline with a safety section and a waste section highlighted, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 报告：结构完整，写明安全和废物。

shots.scene: 可靠来源、规范著录、正确引用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a journal icon, a formatted reference list and quotation marks, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 引用：可靠来源，按国标著录，注明出处。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield of integrity and two students exchanging drafts with a lock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 诚信：不抄不造不改；互评保密客观。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一块断电的电工实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a powered off electrical training bench with meters and terminals, the main switch in the off position, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：电工实验规则与仪表。
